name: Wildcard card stores sell cards whose items were missing from the world package (#10498)
contract: The Skill Card and Golden Skill Card stores list every non-legendary, non-starter Wildcard Hero card in SkillCard.dbc. 403 of those card items had no item_template row, so CMSG_PURCHASE_CUSTOM_STORE_ITEM (0x06BB: u32 item, u32 count) failed in CanStoreNewItem and answered PURCHASE_CUSTOM_STORE_ITEM_UNKNOWN. Golden Skill Card - Seal of Command (2206244) and Golden Skill Card - Aspect of the Beast (2206176) cost 250 Golden Darkmoon Tickets (97399) each; Skill Card - Summoner's Armor (2206339) costs 250 Darkmoon Tickets (246190). Expected: each purchase puts the card in the bags and takes its 250 tickets.

steps.label: Buy Golden Skill Card - Seal of Command
DISCRIMINATING: Golden Skill Card - Seal of Command is in the bags
Buy Golden Skill Card - Aspect of the Beast
DISCRIMINATING: Golden Skill Card - Aspect of the Beast is in the bags
Both golden cards took 250 Golden Darkmoon Tickets each
DISCRIMINATING: Skill Card - Summoner's Armor is in the bags
The normal card took 250 Darkmoon Tickets
